# TS-2 rev B: electrical architecture

One tower = 4 columns x 16 GPUs = 64 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q (300 W each). Every column is electrically
identical and self-contained: its own CRPS power shelf, busbars, two backplanes, cooling controller and Peltier driver.
This file explains how the boards and harness fit together. The detailed drawings are generated, so read them for
numbers: board packages in `boards/<board>/fab/`, harness in `harness/out/`.

## 1. Boards (all generated by `kgen/` from `boards/<board>/design.py`)

| Board | Qty / tower | Size, layers | Job |
|---|---|---|---|
| CBP-8 GPU backplane | 8 (2 per column) | 268.0 x 434.4 mm, 8 L Megtron 6, 2.0 mm | 8 PCIe x16 CEM slots (x8 electrical), each with an MCIO 8i to the host, 12 V hot-swap (MIC2587-1 + CSD17556Q5B, 33 A breaker), INA181 current monitor, slot 3.3 V buck, PERST# gating, 12V-2x6 GPU power header; STM32G474 slot manager |
| CPD-1 column power | 4 | 250.0 x 95.0 mm, 6 L 4 oz, 2.4 mm | 4 CRPS 2000 W (3 + 1) plug in; 16 M6 studs to the +12 V / RTN straps; one PMBus per PSU; VSB OR-ing; power-on gate (PSON_REQ# from CCM-1) |
| CCM-1 cooling controller | 4 | 160.0 x 100.0 mm, 4 L, 1.6 mm | dew point (SHT45), coil dP (SDP810), 6 NTC, 2 leak, 2 flow, D5 pump PWM/tach, chiller run / alarm / 0-10 V set point, light bar, door switches, power interlock; master of the column bus |
| TCD-1 Peltier driver | 4 | 150.0 x 110.0 mm, 4 L 2 oz, 1.6 mm | 4 x 14 A synchronous buck channels (LM5109B + CSD17578Q5A / CSD17556Q5B + 6.8 uH), DC drive into the TECs, 2 hot-side fans, 2 NTC |

Same MCU (STM32G474RET6), same 3.3 V buck (TPS54302), same RS-485 transceiver (THVD1420) on every board, so one
firmware base and one spares kit.

## 2. Power tree (per column)

```
AC feed A/B ──> 4 x CRPS 2000 W (Murata D1U54T-W-2000-12, N+1) ──> CPD-1 (3 x 4 oz +12 V planes, 3 x 4 oz RTN planes)
                                                                   └─ 8 + 8 M6 studs ─> straps TS2B-232/233
                                                                      └─ C01/C02: 2 x 4/0 AWG per pole ─> busbars TS2B-215/216 (14 x 10 Cu)
                                                                         └─ CBP-8 lower + upper: 4 x M6 studs each
                                                                            └─ per slot: hot-swap 33 A ─> 12V-2x6 + slot 12 V pins ─> GPU
               CRPS VSB (12 V standby) ─> CPD-1 VSB_BUS (Schottky OR) ─> CPD-1 MCU 3.3 V; C14 ─> CCM-1 (backup supply)
AC ──> RSP-750-12 (arm) ─> C03: TCD-1 (TECs, fans)   C04: CCM-1 12V_AUX (pump, light bar, logic)
```

Column 12 V load: 16 x 300 W = 4.8 kW, about 400 A. Three CRPS give 6 kW (80 % loaded), and the fourth is the
redundant unit. Each busbar is 14 x 10 mm copper, 140 mm², fed at its bottom end. That is 2.9 A/mm² over the 0.45 m below the lower
CBP-8 and 1.4 A/mm² above it, in the plenum air stream. Behind each CBP-8 the stack is: board, 6 mm Cu bush, +12 V bar,
2 mm FR4 spacer, RTN bar, on M6 x 35 press-fit studs. The RTN studs pass the +12 V bar through 18 mm Cu bushes in PTFE
sleeves. The CPD-1 straps TS2B-232/233 are flat 6 mm Cu with lug paddles above the board edge, one 4/0 cable per end. Each slot's breaker is 33 A against a 25 A GPU.

## 3. Buses

- **Column RS-485** (Modbus RTU, 115200 8E1). CCM-1 is the master and is terminated at its end. The chain runs
  CCM-1 → TCD-1 → CPD-1 → CBP-8 lower → CBP-8 upper (terminated: fit R904 + JP901). Addresses are CPD-1 0x10,
  TCD-1 0x30, CBP-8 0x20 + 2 ADDR1 + ADDR0 (straps in the plug). Pins 4/5 (ADDR) are never carried between nodes.
- **Tower RS-485.** It runs from the host USB-RS485 adapter (terminated) through CCM-1 in columns 1, 2, 3 and 4 to
  TMC-1 (impellers, terminated). CCM-1 answers at 0x40 + column - 1, set by the strap plug on J3.
- **PCIe.** Each GPU gets Gen4 x8 over one MCIO 8i cable to a HighPoint Rocket 1628A switch card in the arm host
  (4 cards per column, 4 ports each).

## 4. Power-on interlock (firmware contract)

1. AC on. CRPS VSB starts CPD-1. The RSP-750-12 starts CCM-1 and TCD-1. GPUs stay unpowered (PS_ON held off).
2. CCM-1 starts the pump and the chiller run relay, then waits for:
   - flow above 4 L/min on both meters;
   - coolant supply at least dew point + 2 K (SHT45 dew point);
   - no leak and doors closed.
3. CCM-1 pulls PSON_REQ# low (C14). CPD-1 asserts PS_ON on every present PSU with AC_OK. COL_PWR_OK follows once
   3 or more report PW_OK.
4. CBP-8 brings slots up one at a time, 50 ms apart (ON → hot-swap ramp 18 ms → PG → slot 3.3 V → PERST# released
   when the host PERST# is high).
5. Fault handling:
   - A leak, a flow loss, or the coolant dropping below dew + 1 K: CCM-1 releases PSON_REQ# after a 30 s GPU-throttle
     warning to the host on the tower bus.
   - A slot over-current: the MIC2587-1 latches that slot off and the CBP-8 reports it.

## 5. PCIe Gen4 loss budget (estimate; replace with first-article S-parameters)

Bump-to-bump budget: 28 dB at 8 GHz.

| Item | Estimate |
|---|---|
| Host switch package and card | 3.5 dB |
| MCIO connectors (x2) | 1.0 dB |
| Cable | 30 AWG 3.3 dB/m, 28 AWG 2.7 dB/m, 26 AWG 2.2 dB/m |
| CBP-8 stripline, Megtron 6 | 0.024 dB/mm, 84-227 mm per lane |
| CEM connector | 0.5 dB |
| GPU add-in card allocation | 8.0 dB |

Cable lengths come from the routed harness path. They are:
- 1.0 m for the lowest slot;
- 1.25-1.75 m for the rest of the lower group;
- 1.5-2.25 m for the upper group.

The gauge steps up to keep the loss down: 30 AWG up to 1.0 m, 28 AWG up to 1.75 m, 26 AWG beyond. Every link lands
at 20.2-22.8 dB, which leaves **5.2-7.8 dB of margin** (TS2B-ELE-102, sheet "Gen4 loss budget"). The upper-group
cables are custom length, so confirm the assemblies. If any link trains below 16 GT/s on the first article, the
fallback is a Gen4 redriver add-in card at the host end of the upper-group cables.

## 6. Cooling electronics

- **Air path.** The GPU blowers feed the plenum. The tracing coil sits on the inlet side and carries chilled water;
  the crown impellers exhaust. The impellers are driven by TMC-1, and CCM-1 reads impeller 3's tach.
- **Coolant temperature.** The supply is held at dew point + 2 K or more (17.5 C design), using the chiller remote set
  point (0-9.9 V from CCM-1) and the TEC trim. The 4 TECs per column (TCD-1) close the last 1-2 K.
- **Trim power.** TCD-1 drives the TECs with DC (an LC-filtered buck, not PWM into the module) because ripple
  current costs TEC COP. That gives 4 x 14 A per column from the RSP-750-12.

## 7. What is verified and what is not

- **Verified by script.**
  - For every board, KiCad's own netlist export matches the design table (`build/netlist-check.txt`).
  - DRC results are in `fab/<board>-drc.rpt`.
  - The harness wire list is built from the board connector pin maps.
- **Not verified yet.** These are listed in `part-verification.md`:
  - the custom land patterns (CEM slot, MCIO, 12V-2x6, CRPS receptacle, press-fit studs);
  - supplier part numbers marked [verify];
  - the loss-budget allocations above.
